name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
implementingAgency: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
briefDescription: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of non-preventable natural risks.
keyBenefits: Extremely low premium: Only 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
Full sum insured payout without capping or reduction in sum insured
Localized calamity coverage for hailstorm, landslide, inundation, and post-harvest cyclone damage
eligibilitySummary: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Must have insurable interest in the insured crop
Crop loss intimation must be submitted within 72 hours of localized calamity
documentsRequired: Land Ownership Document (Khasra / Khatauni / Jamabandi copy)
Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Village Agriculture Extension Officer
Bank Account Passbook copy with active IFSC code
applicationProcedure: Submit claim intimation within 72 hours through the National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), Crop Insurance Mobile App, or Toll-Free Helpline 14447.

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
implementingAgency: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
briefDescription: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of all landholding farmers families.
keyBenefits: Assists in procuring farm inputs (seeds, fertilizer, diesel) ahead of sowing cycles
eligibilitySummary: All landholder farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names
Mandatory eKYC completion through OTP or facial biometric authentication
Institutional landholders and high-income tax payees are excluded
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card linked with active mobile number
Bank Account details linked with NPCI / Aadhaar
applicationProcedure: Self-registration available on pmkisan.gov.in under 'Farmers Corner' or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
briefDescription: Issues soil health cards to farmers every 2 years indicating status of 12 vital macro and micro-nutrients to reduce fertilizer overdose.
keyBenefits: Customized dosage guidance for Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Secondary & Micronutrients
Estimated 15-25% reduction in chemical fertilizer cost through targeted application
Soil physical parameters (pH, EC, Organic Carbon) assessment
eligibilitySummary: Open to all operational agricultural landholders across India.
applicationProcedure: Contact the nearest Block Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for soil sample collection.
